hero_title: Emergency Support For Foreigners In Thailand
hero_desc: Language barriers, unfamiliar laws, and medical emergencies can turn a dream trip into a nightmare. The EMERAAS Emergency Card guarantees 24/7 on-site and remote dispatch aid in your native tongue.
card_desc: Keep this card with you in your wallet or on your phone. In case of an accident, arrest, or medical emergency, scanning the QR code connects you instantly to our multi-lingual emergency desk.
services_section_desc: Five core assistance lines engineered to protect you from language boundaries, administrative traps, and emergency costs.
service_accident_desc: If you get into a road accident, we coordinate translators, liaise with local traffic police, and ensure fair reporting.
service_medical_desc: Fast-track hospital admission. We verify your insurance or financial guarantees so hospitals don't deny emergency treatment.
service_legal_desc: Immediate legal consultation and local bail coordination when dealing with Thai law enforcement, arrests, or disputes.
service_documents_desc: Lost your passport, wallet, or phone? We guide you through police reporting, embassy notification, and replacement documents.
service_critical_desc: Repatriation support, medical evacuation coordination, embassy notifications, and paperwork support during extreme incidents or death.
service_join_desc: Unlock instant peace of mind across Thailand. Starting from only a few hundred baht, ensure you are protected against any unexpected incidents.

about_body_1: EMERAS CO. LTD (known publically as Emeraas Emergency Assistance) is a specialized emergency support organization incorporated in Thailand. Operating from our central dispatch base in Hua Hin (Hin Lek Fai Subdistrict), we provide a 24-hour hotline and field support setup engineered to assist foreigners during critical, unexpected situations.
about_body_2: We believe that language boundaries, unfamiliar laws, and complex medical systems should not prevent expats and tourists from receiving fair, human, and professional treatment in times of crisis.
about_helpdesk_title: Our Central Helpdesk in Hua Hin
about_helpdesk_body: Our hotline desk is operated by multi-lingual Emergency Response Officers fluent in English, Thai, French, and other languages. They are trained in dealing with local traffic police, medical coordinators, and legal bail advisors.
about_join_body: We are constantly expanding our rescue network and local representation across Thailand. If you are based in Hua Hin, Cha-am, Pranburi, or Phetchaburi, we regularly open recruitment for:
about_join_role_1: Emergency Response Officers (Call Center): Fluent in Thai & English, managing emergency cases and liaising with local providers.
about_join_role_2: Independent Sales Representatives: Flexible commission-based agents representing our Emergency Assistance Card.
about_contact_footer: To apply or get in touch regarding partnerships, email us at job@emeraas.com or message us on LINE at @sosemeraas.

accident_desc: Road traffic incidents are among the most common emergencies faced by expats and tourists in Thailand. A minor collision can escalate quickly if there is a language barrier or if you do not understand local reporting procedures.
accident_how_1_desc: Our response team acts as a telephone translator on the spot, explaining the situation to local drivers and emergency responders.
accident_how_2_desc: Dealing with Thai traffic police requires tact and clarity. We liaise with the authorities to ensure the incident report is accurate and your rights are respected.
accident_how_3_desc: If there are injuries, we coordinate with local rescue services and fast-track hospital transport.
accident_tip_desc: If you are in an accident, do not sign any documents in Thai that you do not understand. Dial our emergency hotline at +66 (0) 2 113 1200 immediately.
medical_desc: In Thailand, private hospitals require confirmation of payment guarantee (either cash, credit card, or primary travel insurance approval) before initiating emergency treatment or admitting you to a ward. This can cause critical delays during accidents or severe health crises.
medical_how_1_desc: We work directly with hospital registration desks to verify your Emeraas membership and coordinate billing options with international travel insurance providers, ensuring you receive treatment without delay.
medical_how_2_desc: Medical terminology in Thai can be extremely difficult to grasp. Our bilingual desk helps translate symptoms, treatments, and doctors' diagnoses accurately.
medical_how_3_desc: If you are unable to contact your family back home, our desk notifies your emergency contact list and coordinate updates with your embassy.
medical_tip_desc: Always present your digital or printed Emeraas Emergency Card alongside your passport at the hospital lobby. The admission team can scan the QR code to dial our emergency verification desk.
legal_desc: Navigating legal issues, arrests, police interrogations, or contract disputes in a foreign country can be overwhelming, especially with language barriers and different procedural laws. EMERAAS provides immediate, professional legal guidance to protect your rights.
legal_how_1_desc: In case of arrest or detention by police, our response center connects you immediately with qualified legal advisors who explain your situation and options under Thai law.
legal_how_2_desc: If you are detained or facing formal charges, we coordinate with local bail lawyers and embassy officials to expedite your release and manage the necessary paperwork.
legal_how_3_desc: If you need to make a police report or are called in for questioning, we ensure a representative helps translate and protect your statement.
legal_tip_desc: Do not sign any police report or official statement written in Thai unless our legal coordinators or your embassy's representative has reviewed and translated it for you. Call us at +66 (0) 2 113 1200 immediately.
documents_desc: Losing your passport, driver's license, credit cards, or keys in a foreign country can be highly disruptive. EMERAAS guides you through the recovery and replacement process step-by-step, removing administrative hurdles.
documents_how_1_desc: Before replacing any official document, you must file a report at a local police station. We assist you in drafting the report in Thai and accompany you if needed.
documents_how_2_desc: We connect you directly with your national embassy or consulate in Thailand to fast-track emergency passport issuance and travel letters.
documents_how_3_desc: If you lose your wallet or keys, we assist in contact coordination with local banks to freeze your cards and locate locksmiths or recovery agents.
documents_tip_desc: Always keep digital copies of your passport page, visa stamps, and entry stamps securely stored on your email or cloud storage. This makes the replacement process 10 times faster!
critical_desc: Some situations require more than language translation—they require dedicated, compassionate, and highly professional logistics. During severe illness, life-threatening incidents, or the passing of a loved one in Thailand, EMERAAS provides comprehensive administrative and coordination support.
critical_how_1_desc: In the tragic event of death, we interface with local forensic offices, coordinate with funeral directors, manage translation of death certificates, and coordinate international transport in accordance with embassy regulations.
critical_how_2_desc: If you require special medical transport to your home country, we coordinate with local air ambulance providers, retrieve medical logs from Thai hospitals, and arrange check-out clearances.
critical_how_3_desc: We work in direct communication with consular offices, ensuring official notifications are sent, and your family is fully briefed through secure, official channels.
critical_tip_desc: Our dispatch center operates in close compliance with international travel standards and consular networks, providing a reliable point of contact for family members abroad.
